title: Halloween Decorating!
text: Halloween Decorating!. I ordered these specifically for my tiered tray. I thought it would be a fun way to add some new and creative decorations to them. This comes with everything needed to make the potion bottles, except for the potions. I don't mind making my own, but I do wish there had been some suggestions. I know I can do water and food coloring, but what are some other good ideas? I will definitely have to look that up. The quality of the items is good. I love the labels. The artwork on them is very creative!

product_metadata.title: 99 Pcs Halloween Potion Bottles Set,Halloween Decorations Indoor,Apothecary Bottles with Halloween Stickers & Pendants for Halloween Decor,Halloween Tiered Tray Decor Indoor Room Party Supplies
